info.description:
-

The subject
introduces vocabulary and topics around familiar topics such as 
psychology, science, gastronomy, health,
business 
and
 other social issues
 in
the form of dialogues, newsletters and lectures.
-   Learners learn to use notes
while listening; to predict information based on intonation, context, experience
and learned knowledge; to identify the main and detailed message during hearing
as well as the attitude, intonation, and implication of the speaker; to
recognize sounds, accents in words, the meaning of speed and tone in spoken
language to understand the context and situations in other cultures;

clos.loDetails: Understand key words, structures and main content in the listening text.
Apply a variety of listening skills in completing listening tasks and daily communication.
Analyze contents and structures of intermediate/upper-intermediate level listening texts to understand the speaker’s opinions.
